description: Explore UT - vibration monitoring of the ECJ building at UT Austin is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Kenneth Stokoe, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). NHERI@UTexas participated in the Explore UT on March 3rd, 2018. Explore UT is annual campus wide event, hosted by the University of Texas at Austin, which aims to inform students, parents, teachers and community members from across the state about the importance of the public research institution and higher education in Texas. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2RQ42. Keywords: T-Rex, structural dynamic response, forced vibration test. Published 2018-04-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
